subject.title: [security] artifacts pull treats declared zero size as absent and accepts non-empty artifacts

question: Should manifests that omit `size` remain accepted, or should size become a required integrity field for every artifact pull?
rationale: The current representation cannot distinguish omission from explicit zero, and choosing required-size rejection versus backward-compatible optional presence changes the accepted manifest contract.

options.title: Preserve optional size
options.body: Decode size with explicit presence tracking, skip size verification only when omitted, and strictly enforce explicit zero and all other non-negative declarations.

options.title: Require size
options.body: Reject manifests without a size and enforce equality for every non-negative value, accepting a stricter compatibility break for stronger default integrity.

recommendation.title: Preserve optional size
recommendation.body: Decode size with explicit presence tracking, skip size verification only when omitted, and strictly enforce explicit zero and all other non-negative declarations.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest recent history around artifact manifest security and integrity behavior, although final policy approval should come from a repository decision-maker.
